What is a jump box (jump host)?
A hardened system that administrators connect to first before accessing other devices in a secure network
What is the PRIMARY purpose of a jump box?
To provide a single, controlled, and monitored entry point for administrative access
Which term is another name for a jump box?
Where is a jump box typically placed?
In a secure management network or screened subnet between administrators and protected systems
In the public internet with no firewall
Why should network devices allow SSH only from the jump box's IP address?
It limits management access to a single controlled source
A company wants all administrative access to production servers to be logged and controlled. Which solution is BEST?
Require administrators to connect through a jump box with session logging
Allow direct RDP from the internet
Which security practice should be applied to a jump box?
Hardening, patching, MFA, and minimal installed software
Allowing all users to log in
Why should multifactor authentication be required on a jump box?
Compromising the jump box could give access to many critical systems
Which risk exists if a jump box is compromised?
Attackers may gain access to all systems it can reach
Which feature allows a jump box to record administrators' actions for audits?
Which statement BEST describes the relationship between jump boxes and privileged access management (PAM)?
PAM solutions often include jump servers with credential vaulting and session monitoring
Jump boxes cannot be used with PAM
Which BEST describes credential vaulting in a jump box environment?
Storing privileged passwords securely so administrators don't need to know them directly
A network team must allow a vendor to manage a firewall temporarily. Which approach is MOST secure?
Provide time-limited access through a monitored jump box with MFA
Give the vendor the admin password permanently
Allow Telnet from the vendor's office
Which protocols are commonly used to connect to a jump box?
SSH or RDP over a VPN or secure network
Which SSH feature allows an administrator to connect through a jump host to a target device in one command?
Which statement about jump boxes and segmentation is TRUE?
Jump boxes support segmentation by allowing management networks to remain isolated from user networks
Jump boxes remove the need for segmentation
Jump boxes must be on the guest network
Which practice reduces the risk of malware on a jump box spreading to production systems?
Prohibit web browsing and email on the jump box
Use the jump box as a personal workstation
Which BEST describes a privileged access workstation (PAW)?
A dedicated, hardened workstation used only for administrative tasks
A security audit finds that administrators manage switches directly from their everyday laptops, which they also use for email and browsing. What is the BEST recommendation?
Use a jump box or privileged access workstation for administrative tasks
Which firewall rule BEST supports a jump box design?
Allow management protocols to devices only from the jump box
Allow management from any internal host
Which statement BEST describes cloud jump boxes?
Cloud environments often use bastion hosts or managed bastion services to access private resources
Cloud jump boxes require console cables
Cloud jump boxes are wireless APs
Which BEST describes the benefit of a managed bastion service in the cloud?
Secure access to VMs without exposing them to the internet with public IPs
Which logging practice is MOST important for a jump box?
Forwarding logs to a central SIEM so they can't be easily altered
Keeping logs only on the jump box
A jump box has not been patched in a year. What is the MAIN risk?
Known vulnerabilities could be exploited to compromise the gateway to critical systems
Which access model should be applied to jump box accounts?
Least privilege, granting only the access each administrator needs
Which statement about shared accounts on a jump box is TRUE?
They should be avoided because they remove individual accountability
Which BEST describes just-in-time access on a jump box?
Granting access only for the time needed to complete a task
Which BEST explains why jump boxes are used for out-of-band or management networks?
They provide a secure bridge from the corporate network to the isolated management network
They remove the need for firewalls
Which configuration would allow administrators to manage devices in a management VLAN without giving all users access?
Place a jump box with access to the management VLAN and restrict other access with ACLs
Put all users in the management VLAN
Which attack technique might target a jump box to gain broad access?
Credential theft or exploitation of the jump box itself
SSID spoofing at a coffee shop
Which BEST describes the relationship between a jump box and a VPN?
Administrators may connect via VPN first, then use the jump box to reach protected systems
A jump box replaces all VPNs
VPNs replace jump boxes in every case
Which statement about file transfers through a jump box is TRUE?
File transfers should be controlled and logged to prevent data exfiltration or malware introduction
Which practice helps ensure a jump box remains available for administrators?
Using one jump box with no backup
Turning off the jump box nightly
Which BEST describes a hardened jump box operating system?
Unnecessary services removed, secure configurations applied, and only required tools installed
Which type of monitoring should be applied to jump box sessions?
Real-time alerts for unusual activity and full session recording
A company requires that no administrator connect directly to database servers. Which architecture enforces this?
A jump box with firewall rules allowing database administration only from it
Open firewall rules for all admins
Which BEST describes the term 'pivoting' in the context of jump boxes?
An attacker using a compromised system to reach other systems
Which statement BEST describes a jump box's role in compliance?
It helps demonstrate controlled and audited administrative access
Which tool would an administrator MOST likely run from a jump box to manage network switches?
A web browser for social media
Which BEST describes the main difference between a jump box and a VPN concentrator?
A jump box is a host administrators log into to reach systems; a VPN concentrator creates encrypted tunnels for network access
A jump box encrypts tunnels for all users
A VPN concentrator records RDP sessions
Which access control should be applied to the jump box itself?
Allow connections only from authorized administrator networks or VPN
Which BEST describes the benefit of using a jump box when managing devices across multiple sites?
Administrators use one secure, consistent entry point rather than exposing every device
Which statement about jump box session timeouts is TRUE?
Idle sessions should time out to reduce the risk of unattended access
Which action should be taken when an administrator leaves the company?
Immediately disable their jump box and privileged accounts
Which statement BEST describes the use of MFA prompts on jump box connections?
MFA verifies the administrator's identity before allowing access to critical systems
A penetration test shows that attackers who compromise a user's laptop can SSH directly to core routers. What is the BEST fix?
Restrict router management to a jump box and management network only
Which BEST describes the relationship between jump boxes and zero trust?
Jump boxes can enforce identity verification and least privilege for administrative access
They violate zero trust in all cases
Zero trust removes the need for authentication
Which configuration helps detect if someone bypasses the jump box?
Alerting on management connections to devices from any source other than the jump box
Which BEST describes why a jump box should be dedicated to administrative use?
Limiting its use reduces exposure to malware and simplifies monitoring
It removes the need for patches
Which BEST summarizes the jump box concept?
A hardened, monitored intermediary host that provides controlled administrative access to protected systems
A load balancer for web traffic
